intelligence.human_view: "Bonus" and "double points once a thousand join" describe the same reward, and the difference is everything. A bonus is a gift — given, free, extra, unearned by anything in particular. "Double points once a thousand join" is a milestone — earned by the collective act of a thousand people joining, arriving exactly when the thing that earns it happens. The word "bonus" tells the citizen the reward is spare change handed out; the milestone wording tells them they are part of a thousand founders building something together, and the doubling is the moment the thousand is complete. The timing rule is the same lesson in time: pay the reward up front and it is a bribe for joining; pay it at the thousandth join and it is a celebration of arriving. A reward before its milestone is spent before it is earned — and a system that pays before the milestone teaches its citizens that milestones do not matter. The word and the timing are one rule: the reward follows the achievement, in language and in time.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you and your friends are building the biggest tower ever, and when the thousandth block goes on top, everyone gets double stickers! You don't give the double stickers at the START — that would be silly, the tower isn't built yet! You wait until the tower is finished, and then — POP! — double stickers for everyone! And you don't call them a "bonus" — you call them what they are: double points for a thousand founders!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — you don't give the prize before the race is run! The first thousand founders get half price, and the moment the thousandth one joins, everyone's points double and the price goes up to full. That's the celebration — it arrives when the thousand arrives, not a moment before. And we don't call it a "bonus," like spare change — we call it what it is: double points, once a thousand founders join.
intelligence.naya_view: I never say "bonus." The first thousand founders get half price — and when the thousandth joins, double points, right then, and the price doubles to full. The reward follows the milestone, in words and in time.
